results.rationale: The two-cup arrangement becomes three apparent cup openings, changing cup count and geometry. The left cup is still facing forward beside the upright cup rather than placed on it. Soft rendering, a vertical tonal seam and ambiguous intersections reduce image quality.

The room, pedestal, viewpoint and most of David remain closely preserved. This is still the male David with both arms, rather than the Venus de Milo; cracks merely damage one arm. The edited arm has conspicuous broken contours and a blurry patch. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid.
